title: coil
description: The description of a magnetic coil

bobbin.title: BobbinDataOrNameUnion
bobbin.description: Bobbin(s) for this coil. Scalar (single Bobbin object or name) describes a single bobbin (typically around the centre column). Array describes per-column bobbins for multi-column magnetics (e.g. 3-phase transformers). Convention A: bobbins[i] is mounted on core.columns[i] (index 0 = centre/main column).

oneOf.description: The name of the bobbin used in the core
Array of bobbins, one per core column (Convention A). Element i is the bobbin on core.columns[i]; element 0 is the centre/main column.
The name of the bobbin used in this column

functionalDescription.description: Coil data described in functional terms (the windings, per IEV 151-13-17), in a form suitable for purely magnetic analytical models.
functionalDescription.title: coilFunctionalDescription

groupsDescription.description: Coil data at the group level. A group may define a PCB or distinct winding windows.

sectionsDescription.description: Coil data at the section level, suitable for more advanced analytical and finite-element models.

layersDescription.description: The data from the coil at the layer level, in a way that can be used by more advanced analytical and finite element models

turnsDescription.description: The data from the coil at the turn level, in a way that can be used by the most advanced analytical and finite element models

turn.description: Data describing one turn in a magnetic
turn.title: turn

winding.description: The name of the winding that this turn belongs to

parallel.description: The index of the parallel that this turn belongs to

layer.description: The name of the layer that this turn belongs to

section.description: The name of the section that this turn belongs to

orientation.description: Way in which the turn is wound
orientation.title: turnOrientation

length.description: The length of the turn, referred from the center of its cross section, in m

angle.description: The angle that the turn does, useful for partial turns, in degrees

dimensions.description: Dimensions of the rectangle defining the turn

rotation.description: Rotation of the rectangle defining the turn, in degrees

coordinates.description: The coordinates of the center of the turn, referred to the center of the main column

additionalCoordinates.description: List of additional coordinates of the center of the turn, referred to the center of the main column, in case the turn is not symmetrical, as in toroids

coordinateSystem.description: System in which dimension and coordinates are in
coordinateSystem.title: coordinateSystem

layer.description: Data describing one layer in a magnetic
layer.title: layer

section.description: The name of the section that this layer belongs to

orientation.description: Way in which the layer is oriented inside the section
orientation.title: windingOrientation

turnsAlignment.description: Way in which the turns are aligned inside the layer
turnsAlignment.title: coilAlignment

partialWindings.description: List of partial windings in this layer

insulationMaterial.description: In case of insulating layer, the material used

dimensions.description: Dimensions of the rectangle defining the layer

coordinates.description: The coordinates of the center of the layer, referred to the center of the main column

additionalCoordinates.description: List of additional coordinates of the center of the layer, referred to the center of the main column, in case the layer is not symmetrical, as in toroids

coordinateSystem.description: System in which dimension and coordinates are in
coordinateSystem.title: coordinateSystem

fillingFactor.description: How much space in this layer is used by wires compared to the total

windingStyle.description: Defines if the layer is wound by consecutive turns or parallels

group.description: Data describing one group in a magnetic, which can include several sections. Ideally this is used for PCB or different winding windows
group.title: group

sectionsOrientation.description: Way in which the sections are oriented inside the winding window
sectionsOrientation.title: windingOrientation

partialWindings.description: List of partial windings in this group

dimensions.description: Dimensions of the rectangle defining the group

coordinates.description: The coordinates of the center of the section, referred to the center of the main column

coordinateSystem.description: System in which dimension and coordinates are in
coordinateSystem.title: coordinateSystem

windingWindow.description: Index of the winding window (in the windingWindows list of the governing bobbin or core processed description) the sections of this group are placed in. If not present, the first winding window (index 0) is assumed. Overridable per section

pcb.description: PCB manufacturing description of the board that realises a printed group (MAS-RFC 0012). Optional: consumers that draw the board (PCB generation, planar real-winding placement) require it and fail without it; electromagnetic consumers ignore it. Forbidden on non-printed groups.

section.description: Data describing one section in a magnetic
section.title: section

layersOrientation.description: Way in which the layers are oriented inside the section
layersOrientation.title: windingOrientation

partialWindings.description: List of partial windings in this section

layersAlignment.description: Way in which the layers are aligned inside the section
layersAlignment.title: coilAlignment

numberLayers.description: Optional field to force how many layers must fit in a section

dimensions.description: Dimensions of the rectangle defining the section

coordinates.description: The coordinates of the center of the section, referred to the center of the main column

coordinateSystem.description: System in which dimension and coordinates are in
coordinateSystem.title: coordinateSystem

fillingFactor.description: How much space in this section is used by wires compared to the total

windingStyle.description: Defines if the section is wound by consecutive turns or parallels

windingOrder.description: Order in which consecutive layers are wound within this section. 'U' alternates the winding direction every layer (back-and-forth); 'Z' winds every layer in the same direction with a return wire (foldback). If unset, the winding window's windingOrder applies, else 'Z'.
windingOrder.title: windingOrder

margin.description: Defines the distance at the extremes of the section reserved for margin tape. Two-element array, from 'inner or top' to 'outer or bottom'.

group.description: The name of the group that this section belongs to

windingWindow.description: Index of the winding window (in the windingWindows list of the governing bobbin or core processed description) this section is placed in. If not present, the group's windingWindow applies, else the first winding window (index 0). Coordinates stay referred to the center of the main column regardless of this value

marginInfo.description: Data describing the information about the margin of a section
marginInfo.title: marginInfo

topOrLeftWidth.description: Width of the margin in the top or left side of the section, along where the clearance would happen. Also the width of the tape to implement it.

bottomOrRightWidth.description: Width of the margin in the bottom or right side of the section, along where the clearance would happen. Also the width of the tape to implement it.

insulationMaterial.description: In case of insulating layer, the material used

numberLayers.description: Number of layers to implement the margin

layerThickness.description: Thickness of the layers used to implement the margin.

partialWinding.description: One part of a winding, described by the proportion of each parallel that is contained here.
partialWinding.title: partialWinding

winding.description: Name of the winding that this part belongs to.

parallelsProportion.description: Per-parallel proportion of turns contained in this part.

items.description: Proportion of turns contained in this part for the parallel at this index.

connections.description: Two-element array representing the input and output connections of this partial winding.

winding.description: One winding (assembly of interconnected turns and/or coils intended for common operation, per IEV 151-13-17). Examples: primary, secondary, auxiliary.

name.description: Name of the winding (e.g. primary, secondary).

numberTurns.description: Number of turns (per IEV 151-13-14) in the winding.

numberParallels.description: Number of parallel-connected conductors making up one electrical turn of the winding.

connections.description: Array of all the pins this winding is connected to.

woundWith.description: List of winding names that are wound together with this winding.

windingWindow.description: Index of the winding window (in the windingWindows list of the governing bobbin or core processed description) this winding is intended to be placed in, used by auto-winders and advisers before sections exist. If not present, the first winding window (index 0) is assumed. Overridable per group and per section

connection.description: Connection of a wire to a terminal.

metric.description: Metric of the terminal, if applicable.

pinName.description: Name of the pin where the wire is connected, if applicable.

direction.description: Direction of the current in the connection.

length.description: Length of the connection, from the exit of the last turn to the terminal. Unit: m.

footprint.description: Library footprint realising this terminal on a PCB, as <library>:<footprint> (e.g. Connector_Pin:Pin_D1.0mm_L10.0mm). When absent the generator derives a footprint from type, diameter and metric.

diameter.description: Pin diameter for pin terminals. Unit: m.

gender.description: Terminal gender, for screw/press-fit terminal blocks.

mounting.description: Mounting of the terminal on the PCB.

padWidth.description: For pcbPad terminals: pad extent along the board width. Unit: m.

padDepth.description: For pcbPad terminals: pad extent along the board depth. Unit: m.

landPattern.description: Recommended land pattern of the terminal (PEAS).

pcbVias.description: Via specification shared by every layer transition of the board.
pcbVias.title: pcbVias

diameter.description: Outer (copper) diameter of the via. Unit: m.

drillDiameter.description: Finished drill diameter of the via. Unit: m.

pcbDesignRules.description: Copper spacing rules the layout is drawn to. Unit: m. Minimums; the generator places copper at exactly these distances.
pcbDesignRules.title: pcbDesignRules

trackToTrack.description: Copper edge to copper edge between adjacent tracks (turn pitch minus track width).

coreToTrack.description: Copper edge to the core cut-outs (central column and lateral legs). Also the copper-to-board-edge rule unless copperToEdge is given.

viaToVia.description: Copper edge to copper edge between adjacent vias.

viaToTrack.description: Copper edge between a via and a track of another net.

copperToEdge.description: Copper edge to the board outline. Defaults to coreToTrack when absent (stated rule, not a fallback).

holeToHole.description: Drill edge to drill edge between any two holes (fabrication rule).

holeToCopper.description: Drill edge to copper of another net (fabrication rule).

pcbOutline.description: Board outline. The core cut-outs are derived from the core processed description, not stored here. Unit: m.
pcbOutline.title: pcbOutline

width.description: Board extent along the axis that crosses the winding window (terminal side to terminal side).

depth.description: Board extent along the lateral legs axis.

cornerRadius.description: Radius of the board corners. 0 or absent: square corners.

coreCutoutClearance.description: Gap between the core column faces and the cut-out edges. Defaults to coreToTrack when absent (stated rule).

pcbOuterDielectric.description: Dielectric above the top copper and below the bottom copper (prepreg, solder mask). Inter-layer dielectrics are the insulation layers of layersDescription. Unit: m.
pcbOuterDielectric.title: pcbOuterDielectric

pcb.description: Manufacturing description of the printed circuit board that realises a printed group. A printed group is one PCB; a stacked planar magnetic is one printed group per board. Optional on the group: only PCB-drawing consumers need it (MAS-RFC 0012).
pcb.title: pcb
